settings.title: The Ritual
settings.content:
Restore Balm + Recovery Cream · 60 ml each · one sealed set.

The Ritual Duo doesn’t come apart. Not as a bundle deal, not as a starter pack — as one sealed system, formulated as a pair and sold as a pair.

Step one — Restore Balm. Richer · Sealing · Protective. For fresh ink. Thin layer, clean dry skin, morning and night.

Step two — Recovery Cream. Calm · Condition · Refresh. For the second stage. A lighter daily cream that sinks in fast to hydrate and soothe while the work settles — the months most people skip.

settings.title: The night, the morning, the second stage
settings.content:
The night. A few hours after the session: wrap off, a gentle wash, and nothing on it. Let the skin breathe overnight.

The morning after. Restore Balm, thin. Keep it thin, keep it regular, through the first days.

The second stage. Recovery Cream, morning and night, through the months it takes to settle. Most people stop at week two. Don’t.

Always follow the aftercare your artist gives you — they know what they put in your skin.

settings.title: Heavy work — the layered protocol
settings.content:
Big work is not a big version of small work. A multi-session rework over old ink, a full back, a solid black fill — the skin takes far more than a single-sitting piece ever will. Heavy work needs its own protocol.

Critical stage — both, layered. Recovery Cream first, Restore Balm straight over the top.

Closing stage — Restore Balm alone. Thin layer, morning and night.

Second stage — Recovery Cream alone. Weeks out, step down. Daily cream, until it’s settled.
